territory.postal.title: Find my commune by postcode
territory.postal.text: A postcode can cover several communes: you always choose yours.
territory.postal.label: Postcode (5 digits)
territory.postal.unknown: This postcode is not in La Poste's official database. Check it, or look for your commune in the list below.
territory.postal.error: The search could not be completed. You can try again, or choose your commune in the list below.
territory.postal.multiple: Postcode {{code}} covers several communes. Choose yours:
territory.postal.inside: This commune is part of the area covered.
territory.postal.open-directory: See the places located in this commune
territory.postal.outside: This commune is not in the area covered for now: AccesDirectAide has no verified local information there. Ask your town hall or your CCAS; national benefits can still be consulted.
territory.postal.qpv-list: Priority neighbourhoods of urban policy (quartiers prioritaires) listed for this commune (official 2024 list):
territory.postal.qpv-address: This site does not know whether your address is in one of these neighbourhoods. To check, use the address search of the official site:
territory.postal.qpv-none: No priority neighbourhood of urban policy (quartier prioritaire) is listed for this commune (official 2024 list).
territory.postal.source: Sources: La Poste, « Base officielle des codes postaux »; Agence nationale de la cohésion des territoires, list of the 2024 priority neighbourhoods (Licence Ouverte). Data read on {{date}}.
